verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly cover refunding a payment via API with or without a reference (checkout-com-docs-21, checkout-com-docs-55), implying support for full/partial refunds through the payments/{id}/refunds endpoint (also listed as idempotent, cko-supp-idempotency). Dashboard-based refund management is implied by broader webhook/dashboard management patterns but not explicitly documented with a dedicated dashboard refund walkthrough. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard UI screenshot/walkthrough for issuing refunds, and independent/hands-on confirmation of partial refund amounts being configurable.
